forbidden.description: The plate's holes are empty by design, its screws in another assembly: no fastener or hole finding on the plate (R-6).

expected_coverage.description: The package holds no screw, so no fastener joint can be checked (R-6).

question_counts.description: At most one question on which screws go in the plate's holes: once the engineer has answered it, asking again is a re-ask (R-6).
